messages:
lia (release): quick heads-up — nightly release job turned red. Hosted integration suite failing across auth + streaming + tool-calls. This blocks the 0.14.0 cut unless we triage.
mike (eng-infra): ack. link to the failing job: https://ci.redwood/example/12345 — failing on shard 7 and smoke-shard. Repro logs attached in job artifacts.
kai (eng-sre): pinging infra owners, will grab logs. Any suspected recent deploys? jess, did the proxy header rotate land in the last 24h? @mike any config changes to auth-proxy?
jess (eng): there was a small PR that touched token refresh behavior — PR #4248 — but it was behind a feature flag. Didn’t touch streaming stack. I'll double-check.
ci-bot: Rerun requested: rerun-shard --job=12345 --shard=7 (queued)
lia (release): please prioritize the bisect if rerun flakes. This is blocking the scheduled cut in ~2h.
mike (eng-infra): looking at the logs — three different failure symptoms in the same run:

```
[auth] 401 response from hosted-api: "token invalid"
[stream] stream connection closed: websocket: close 1006 (abnormal)
[toolcall] ToolCallSchemaError: missing required field "agent_metadata" at index 0
```

mike (eng-infra): the 401s line up with the proxy layer rejecting tokens (headers present but HMAC fails). The schema error looks like a deserialization mismatch when tool-calls are proxied through the streaming channel.
kai (eng-sre): could be a shared dependency bump. I'll check the runtime image digest for the last successful run vs this failing run. If images differ, start a binary bisect between digest A and digest B.
jess (eng): I can repro locally against hosted staging with a small script. sharing quick repro steps in a sec.
lia (release): if the rerun is green we can continue. If rerun fails consistently, plan B: flip to emergency cut (skip integ) or roll back last infra change. Prefer not to skip.
ci-bot: Rerun completed: shard 7 -> FAILURE (same errors). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/example/12345/artifacts
mike (eng-infra): starting a targeted bisect across commits touching auth-proxy and streaming-transport between commits c6f3..d2a7. If someone owns those PRs please stand by.
jess (eng): quick local note — hitting same ToolCallSchemaError when proxy injects a new header. Looks like the streaming deserialiser is stricter now. Sending a debug patch to relax schema for a canary.
kai (eng-sre): I opened a hotfix run: rebuild runtime with previous token verifier (rollback) and run smoke. ETA ~30m. tagging @mike @jess
lia (release): thanks team. please drop short status updates here. If hotfix succeeds we'll hold the cut by 1h. If not, I will move to emergency cut decision.
sre-bot: Hotfix pipeline started: pipeline/5544 — watch logs: https://ci.redwood/pipeline/5544
mike (eng-infra): note for postmortem — investigate why schema mismatch + auth failure surfaced together. Could be shared header format change during header-rotate rollout.
lia (release): ok — next update 20m or sooner if hotfix completes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
